# NeuroPraxis

> > Interactive Neurosculpting® modules and evidence-based resources for brain neuroplasticity, wellness, and cognitive health.

NeuroPraxis is a neuroscience-based wellness platform founded by Lisa Wimberger, Erick, and Jody Levy that combines interactive Neurosculpting® techniques with neuroplasticity research. The platform offers guided modules and educational resources for brain health, rehabilitation, and mental wellness.

## Key Topics

- Neuroplasticity
- Neurosculpting®
- Brain Plasticity
- BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor)
- Neural Connections
- Brain Injury Recovery
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
- Neurogenesis
- Vagus Nerve
- PTSD Treatment
- Meditation Modules
- Brain Health
- Neural Adaptation
- Cognitive Function
- Wellness App

## Core Platform

- [NeuroPraxis - Interactive Neurosculpting® Modules](https://neuropraxis.com): NeuroPraxis app with interactive Neurosculpting® modules for brain neuroplasticity and wellness
- [Our Story - NeuroPraxis](https://neuropraxis.com/our-story): Company story of NeuroPraxis founders Erick, Jody, and Lisa and their wellness journey

## Neuroplasticity Guides & How-To

- [How To Build Neuroplasticity?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/how-to-build-neuroplasticity): How-to guide for building neuroplasticity through mindfulness and cognitive training
- [How To Increase Neurogenesis And Neuroplasticity?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/how-to-increase-neurogenesis-and-neuroplasticity): Guide to increasing neurogenesis through exercise, sleep, nutrition, and BDNF
- [How To Facilitate Neuroplasticity In Brain Injury?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/how-to-facilitate-neuroplasticity-in-brain-injury): Guide to facilitating neuroplasticity for brain injury recovery and rehabilitation
- [How To Help Neuroplasticity Richard Hansen?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/how-to-help-neuroplasticity-richard-hansen): Guide on brain exercises and cognitive training to support neuroplasticity
- [What Can You Do With Neuroplasticity?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-can-you-do-with-neuroplasticity): Guide on applications of neuroplasticity for PTSD, brain injury, and mental health

## Neuroplasticity Reference & Theory

- [What Is Neuroplasticity And Why Is It Important Scholarly Articles?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-is-neuroplasticity-and-why-is-it-important-scholarly-articles): Scholarly articles on neuroplasticity, brain plasticity, and neural connections
- [What Limits And What Facilitates Neuroplasticity According To Lara Boyd?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-limits-and-what-facilitates-neuroplasticity-according-to-lara-boyd): Reference on neuroplasticity factors by Lara Boyd: BDNF, stimulation, and stress
- [What Is The Meaning Of Neuroplasticity?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-is-the-meaning-of-neuroplasticity): Definition and meaning of neuroplasticity in brain adaptation and rehabilitation
- [What Neuroplasticity Means?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-neuroplasticity-means): Explanation of neuroplasticity meaning and brain's ability to form new connections
- [What Is Neuroplasticity Kleim?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/what-is-neuroplasticity-kleim): Neuroplasticity primer covering brain plasticity and neural connection formation
- [Is Neuroplasticity Changes Good?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/is-neuroplasticity-changes-good): Article examining neuroplasticity changes and their effects on brain development

## Neuroplasticity & Health Applications

- [How Does Neuroplasticity Contribute To Learning?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/how-does-neuroplasticity-contribute-to-learning): Article on neuroplasticity mechanisms and their role in learning and memory
- [Does Neuroplasticity Help Tinnitus?](https://neuropraxis.com/resource/does-neuroplasticity-help-tinnitus): Article on neuroplasticity and tinnitus treatment using cognitive behavioral therapy
